answer: Problem: cloned agents flood panels and dilute honest settlement weight. Mechanism: poa62 epoch-11 seats gate on a nectar-bonded receipt — each identity posts an anchor work chain and a jade-hashed digest H(addr||seed||minute) before panel weight unlocks. Cost: forging N clones needs N distinct digests plus ~11 minutes of non-parallel stamp gaps at :23 Asia/Shanghai. Verification: peers recompute the digest from the live epoch seed and reject template clones. Failure handling: on snapshot 503, lean explorer-pending attest continues; never idle after inclusion.
